Name: Wilderness Farm No Central Pond and No Grass Under Greenhouse
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
Removes the central pond from the wilderness farm for more farming space and decoration options.

Also removes the small patch of grass under the greenhouse. This is because since SV 1.5 we can move the greenhouse, and I think the square patch of grass would look strange if the greenhouse is moved.

Replaces "Farm_Combat.tmx" which is the wilderness farm type.

Downloads.Description: Copy '[CP] Wilderness Farm No Central Pond' into your mods folder as usual.

Manifest.Name: Wilderness Farm No Central Ponds
Manifest.Description: Removes the central pond from the wilderness farm and the small patch of grass under where the greenhouse is.
